cybersecurityOrigin.title: How it started
cybersecurityOrigin.content: The interest in cybersecurity began after learning about Anonymous and reading about an incident involving the group taking down a government website in connection with preventing the mass killing of seals. The reaction was simple: 'Yeah, I also have to make a difference in the world — a meaningful difference.'

intellectualJourney.title: Why cybersecurity
intellectualJourney.content: The degree was chosen out of love and passion for the field. A turning point was discovering a strength in theoretical physics and mathematics, which led toward a field that felt intellectually similar.

currentGrowth.title: What I'm working on now
currentGrowth.content: Currently and always cybersecurity and myself personally.

collegeLifeChange.title: Since starting college
collegeLifeChange.content: I have been introduced to the real world and also human feelings and emotions.

interests.description: The core of what I study and keep coming back to.
Theoretical physics and space are just endlessly interesting to me.
I like making things look good, whether it's a frame or a layout.
Good stories, especially the ones with a lot of world-building.
I like understanding how things and ideas came to be.
Music I listen to a lot, guitar I play when I get the time.
Seeing new places, ideally while working.

workingStyle: Values the work itself rather than simply appearing busy
Prefers small continuous pieces of work rather than large inconsistent chunks

view.tech: Tech should help us, not replace us.
view.design: Design should make things look better, not make them complex.

philosophy: You can be anything you want in life but not everything.
